summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Kridhani Jewels e-commerce website. Backend APIs working well (92.9% success rate), frontend loads correctly with good mobile responsiveness, but found critical cart persistence issue and admin login problem.

minor_bugs.issue: Create product returns status 200 instead of 201
minor_bugs.impact: Minor - functionality works correctly, just wrong status code

critical_bugs.issue: Cart items not persisting between page navigation - cart count shows in navbar but cart page is empty
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot complete purchases as cart empties on navigation

critical_bugs.issue: Admin login form submits but doesn't redirect to dashboard - stays on login page with 'Logging in...' state
critical_bugs.impact: Admin cannot access dashboard to manage products

ui_bugs.issue: Empty cart state not displaying properly when cart is empty

passed_tests: Homepage loads with all sections (navbar, hero, social proof, categories, products, footer)
Product display with 7 products showing correctly with images, prices, badges
Add to Cart button functionality (cart count updates in navbar)
Buy Now button present and functional
Mobile responsiveness - hamburger menu works, product cards properly sized
Mobile navigation and cart icon visible
Backend APIs: Products GET/POST/PUT/DELETE, Categories, Orders, Auth endpoints
Admin authentication API works (backend test passed)
Order creation and notification system working
Categories API returns all expected categories
Product CRUD operations work via API
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical cart persistence issue in CartContext - items added to cart disappear when navigating to cart page. Also fix admin login flow - authentication works via API but frontend login doesn't redirect to dashboard.
